source: PDC CPTAC PDA Discovery Study clinical export supplied by user
interpretation: ID overlap only; it does not prove usable radiomic features or tumor annotations are available.
outcome_definition: Dead: Days to Death, event=1. Alive: Days to Last Follow Up, event=0. Exclude unknown status and missing/nonpositive duration.
model: Penalized Cox proportional hazards model with age, female indicator, high-grade indicator; five-fold shuffled cross-validation, seed 42.
critical_limitations: Clinical-only model; no radiomic features used.
Small exploratory cohort and internal cross-validation only; not external validation.
Reference-paper metrics are not results from this project.
